bullets: Migrated the authentication system from a legacy JWT path to Appwrite’s session-cookie model, covering OAuth start, callback, redirect, error handling and popup re-authentication flow for sensitive operations.

Created a repo-aware RAG pipeline for autonomous issue resolution: Tree-sitter chunking at function/class granularity, OpenAI embeddings stored in per-user Redis, and KNN-grounded LLM plans that reference real files/functions, with incremental re-indexing via a 6h drift ticker that re-embeds only changed files.
Built a dual-recipient invite system on Appwrite, pre-provisioning shadow accounts for new invitees to enable email delivery, while preserving backward compatibility with the legacy invite flow.

Rebuilt the platform’s entire UI from scratch in Astro using React, Tailwind CSS, and DaisyUI, redesigning core dashboards and building 10+ chart types with Chart.js, including custom visualizations to deliver a more modern, consistent, and intuitive interface.
